card.name: Platelet count thresholds and exposure changes
card.fires_on: The unit and number tokens in platelet-count thresholds like '> 400 x 10 9 /L' in dose-adjustment tables. It also fires on words in sentences about a drug interaction raising or lowering exposure.

modes.label: Platelet count limits
modes.description: The 9 or L in '10 9 /L' after a '>' 400 platelet threshold in dose-adjustment instructions.

modes.label: Interaction changing exposure
modes.description: Words like compared, which, or exposure in sentences saying an interacting drug raises or lowers drug levels.
modes.example: concomitant use of vilazodone hydrochloride tablets and strong CYP3A4 inducers decreased the exposure of vilazodone<< compared>> to the use of vilazodone
